verdict.rationale: Mercury publishes an extensive public REST API with interactive reference docs and code samples. It covers transactions, accounts receivable, cards, payments, transfers and webhooks. It also offers scoped API tokens, OAuth2, a sandbox with separate base URLs, versioned /api/v1 paths, a dated changelog with migration guides, an official Go SDK, and an llms.txt index (confirmed by probe) aimed at AI agents. A community comment praises the quality of its exposed software surface. Missing for 10: hands-on independent verification of API calls, an OpenAPI spec at standard paths (probe got 404s), a written deprecation/sunset policy, and official SDKs beyond Go; OAuth access also requires prior approval.
